name: Monthly budget
description: Income and spending for one month, planned against actual, with the difference per line and totals.

name: Invoice
description: A one-page invoice: who it is for, line items with quantities and prices, subtotal, tax and total.

name: Loan schedule
description: A 30-year fixed loan of 250,000 at 5.5%: every monthly payment split into interest and principal, with the balance left.

name: Weekly schedule
description: One week by the hour from 07:00 to 20:00, Monday to Sunday, with a few plans filled in.

name: Task tracker
description: Tasks with an owner, status, priority, due date and percent done.

name: Gradebook
description: Twelve students across five assessments, with each average and a letter grade.
